BTC and XBT wallet update:
- Blue BTC wallets now use Bitcoin SHA-256 with Native SegWit receive addresses. BTC and XBT keep their own chain connections and labels.
- New XBT installations use Kilombino's SSL Fulcrum preset with normal certificate verification.
- Wallet balance and cards stay fixed while transaction history scrolls. Verified-chain status has a green LED.
- Settings and its submenus use centered regular-weight uppercase headings, smaller labels, and adjacent sections. Donate and Support sit together.
- Added Dark Angel and Templar to the saved logo-tap skin cycle.
- Wallet refresh errors that complete after leaving the wallet screen no longer cover Receive.
- Automatic connection failures update connection status without interrupting menus or Add Wallet.
- Lightning hidden balances and sensitive-action checks are tightened. New channels retain the 10,000,000-sat opening cap, and resize progress distinguishes local confirmations from peer lock status.

Please check BTC/XBT labels, receive QR amounts, Settings menus, and the saved skins on your iPhone. Bitcoin connections use direct TLS. Tor covers the embedded Lightning paths and configured watchtowers; it does not register a watchtower, and exchange quotes still use direct HTTPS.
